_method: Method: every Reel was downloaded without signing in (yt-dlp), sampled at one frame per second into contact sheets, and transcribed locally with Whisper (Hebrew, first 90 seconds; the first 18 transcripts with beam search, the rest with greedy decoding to save time). Sonnet agents coded each Reel from all of its frames, transcript, caption and counts with one brief (`src/CODING_BRIEF.md`). I then checked every included Reel myself against its frames: all frames for the eight deep dives, a 10-frame strip plus the coding for the rest (`inspected` says which).

DTugYwmDNKa.why: LumeBook's own creator Reel: the closest match in the sample.
DTugYwmDNKa.lesson: Problem hook, product at 1 s, ordering flow as an overlay, objection answered, honest close.
DTugYwmDNKa.disclosure: Caption: received the book as UGC work; coupon code
DTugYwmDNKa.inspected: all frames, transcript and caption (my own review)

DWW7cLNDZvv.inspected: all frames, transcript and caption (my own review)

DbydNecM1GW.disclosure: No disclosure words; co-author @mebook.ai; DM code after comment ספר

DbAfvCdowT3.why: The one Reel with real photo beside illustrated page, as split screens.
DbAfvCdowT3.lesson: Split-screen likeness proof is the strongest proof format for a personalised book; 125 s is far too long.

DV6fjEojHSs.why: Fast montage of toddlers with their books and the kids' photos laid next to them.
DV6fjEojHSs.lesson: Printed cards with each child's photo lie beside the books at 0:00: a likeness hint without a child on camera.

DVlyDocjXU4.why: Flip-through plus family reading, ending on a screen recording of the site.
DVlyDocjXU4.lesson: A phone screen recording of the product page is an easy, honest last shot for an ordering CTA.
DVlyDocjXU4.disclosure: No disclosure words; co-author @mebook.ai; DM code after comment ספר

DeOUx2NgNbi.why: Smallest creator in the sample (458 followers): a third brand (Funsome).

C9sW-JWxUgJ.lesson: What to avoid: 34 shots in 33.6 s of screen recording and flashing text; the comment-word coupon drives the comments.
C9sW-JWxUgJ.disclosure: Caption: "בשיתוף ממומן @mebook.ai"; comment מיבוק for a code

Dc6VXOdMWOv.why: A book in a professional's hands, with the most plays in the sample after Dd5sq3TI1I5.
